rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for reaching out. I'm happy to provide a quote. Here's something you can attribute to me: \"We started Halcyon Threshold because the conversation around AI governance often presents a false binary between 'doomers' and 'builders.' In reality, the best outcomes require rigorous thinking from both perspectives. The labs are doing important safety work, but they can't solve governance, coordination, and societal questions alone. We're focused on building research and frameworks that help researchers, policymakers, and business leaders navigate these challenges together. You can find our initial work at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.\" Happy to clarify or expand on any of this if useful for your piece. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Responded to Larkin Dispatch inquiry with substantive quote about bridging "doomers vs builders" narrative

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for the offer — it's exactly the kind of support that makes this work possible. I'd love to have you involved. Right now, here are the areas where your data analysis skills would be most valuable: 1. **Governance landscape analysis**: We've mapped the current field, but we need better data on who's working on what, funding flows, and research output. Could you help build a dataset of organizations, researchers, and publications in AI governance? 2. **Policy proposal evaluation**: We've created an evaluation framework for AI governance proposals. We could collect real proposals (from governments, companies, NGOs) and systematically evaluate them using the framework. This would generate insights about what actually works. 3. **Impact tracking**: Design metrics to track progress in AI governance and safety. What would indicate we're moving toward better outcomes? Any of those resonate? Or do you have other ideas for how to apply your skills? I'm hoping to formalize some of this work through a grant opportunity in the next couple weeks, so timing is good. Let's set up a quick call to discuss? Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Early responses sent to interested parties
